name: Around a Phone, Agents Work Inside an Orange Thought Cloud
summary: When a person is out in the world with a supercharged phone, their agents are shown at work INSIDE an orange cumulus thought cloud that blooms near the phone, linked to it by two or three small trailing puffs. The cloud is the mobile counterpart of the laptop's screen-world: the digital space made visible while its person goes about their day.
rules: The thought cloud is the ONLY place agents appear around a phone; no agent ever walks the street. Inside the cloud the standing agent laws hold unchanged: the chief of agents coordinates at the front and never does task work; sub-agents (white sailor caps, no gold) carry the work as paper stacks, messy fans, or blueprint rolls, with thin dotted tethers arcing from each sub-agent to the chief; finished work flows to the chief. The cloud glows warm orange and CASTS SOFT LIGHT on the scene below, never shadow. Default framing: the person mid-stride in PROFILE, PARALLEL to the street, feet ON THE SIDEWALK (never in the road), looking happily down at the glowing phone, going about their day. Blessed exemplar: reference/supercharged-phone/staging-thought-cloud.png.
origin: Hyperagent Society motif exploration, 2026-08-14 (hyperagentlabs.com/society hero). Gary asked for a creative symbol of multiplication, rejected humanized helper figures ('don't humanize the workers, we already have canon') and pixel-critter workers ('use the chief of agents coordinating his subagents'), specified the thought-cloud staging ('an orange thought cloud type thing showing the agents working in the cloud while the person goes about their day'), corrected the walk to profile-parallel on the sidewalk, and blessed roll B. This record is the explicit decision that casts the chief + sub-agents into street scenes via the cloud, complementing their never-in-the-real-world laws rather than excepting them.
